summary: Retested iteration_335 blocker scope. Backend regressions and static V5 structure test pass, but authenticated live Operations UI still shows 0 rendered V5 cards due repeated browser-layer aborted /api requests on preview.

ui_bugs.issue: No `[data-testid^='operation-card-v5-main-']` cards rendered in authenticated mobile runs; required first-card field/toggle/menu/collection-state checks remain blocked.

integration_issues.issue: Preview browser session still reports repeated `net::ERR_ABORTED` for same-origin `/api/*` calls (including `/api/operations?limit=200` and `/api/accounts`), leaving operations count at `0 عملية`.

action_items: Investigate preview-edge/browser abort source for same-origin `/api/*` requests (Cloudflare challenge/transport interruption signs present) and confirm stable request completion in automated browser context.
After request-abort issue is fixed, rerun live checks for first V5 card required fields, additional info toggle, full details toggle, more-actions menu actions, and collection button state.
Keep financial safety: continue validating collection button presence/state only without executing settlement action during retest.
critical_code_review_comments: `/app/frontend/src/pages/Operations.jsx` remains very large (~3800 lines), which increases regression risk and makes fetch/render failures harder to isolate quickly.
Auth startup currently seeds manager PIN idempotently (`ensure_pin`), but no explicit automated check in this run proved an existing admin password-change synchronization path.

success_rate.frontend: 55% (static V5 + mobile overflow passed; live V5 interaction scope blocked by zero rendered cards)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Used public URL from frontend/.env and manager credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Backend tests passed. Playwright mobile run (320/390/430) confirmed no horizontal overflow but still found 0 operation cards and active count `0 عملية`. Console shows repeated `net::ERR_ABORTED` on same-origin `/api/operations?limit=200`, `/api/accounts`, and other `/api/*` requests.
rca of the issue: Repro: login as manager -> open /operations on preview -> operations summary shows `0 عملية` and no V5 cards. Browser console logs show aborted same-origin API requests (`/api/operations`, `/api/accounts`, `/api/vehicles`, etc.), plus challenge-related aborted calls. Backend endpoint health/probe tests pass independently, so failure is most likely preview browser-network/edge request lifecycle, not OperationCard V5 markup.
